title: Choosing Between Similar Functions
query: Remove all spam messages from my inbox that are older than 30 days

tools.name: delete_messages
tools.description: Delete specific messages by their IDs

message_ids.description: Array of message IDs to delete

older_than_days.description: Delete messages older than this many days

tools.name: empty_spam_folder
tools.description: Delete all messages in spam folder

explanation: This requires careful analysis. User wants spam messages FROM INBOX (not spam folder), filtered by age (30 days). The best function is bulk_delete_by_criteria because: (1) It can filter by folder (inbox), (2) It can filter by labels (['spam']), (3) It can filter by age (older_than_days: 30). Other options don't work: delete_messages requires specific IDs (we don't have them), empty_spam_folder empties the spam folder (but messages are in inbox), mark_as_spam doesn't delete.
hints: User wants spam messages FROM INBOX, not from spam folder
Need to filter by: location (inbox), label (spam), and age (30 days)
delete_messages won't work - we don't have specific message IDs
empty_spam_folder won't work - messages are in inbox, not spam folder
